answer.explanation: From 22:27 to 22:37 the ThumbnailerFunction logged a continuous stream of AccessDenied errors (about 370 in the window, roughly 40 per minute) on s3:PutObject to the output bucket. The live inline policy app-policy on ThumbnailerRole only allows s3:GetObject on the input bucket; the WriteOutput statement granting s3:PutObject on OutputBucket/* is missing. The IaC template declares that statement, so the intended state is correct and the drift is in the deployed role. Live function configuration (memory, timeout, environment, concurrency) matches the IaC for all four functions, and the Lambda configs were last modified before the window, so CONFIG and IAC are ruled out.
